name: Keeper of the Siren Song
source:
You were never supposed to be the Keeper of the Siren Song, but now that you’ve snuck into the Trial and deceived everyone, can you convince one of the mer princes to fall in love with you?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
原本怎么也轮不到你来守护海妖之歌。可你已经偷偷混进试炼，瞒过了所有人。现在，你能让其中一位人鱼王子爱上你吗？

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]］
